description: This Flutter widget represents an EKYC (Electronic Know Your Customer) status screen, periodically fetching and displaying the user's EKYC status with error handling and refresh capabilities.

classes.name: EKYCStatusScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that displays the current EKYC status, periodically updating its data.

classes.name: _EKYCStatusScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the data fetching, periodic updates, error handling, and UI rendering for EKYCStatusScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, loads initial data, and sets up a periodic timer to refresh data every 6 seconds.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Fetches the EKYC status from backend API, updates the state with the result, or sets an error message.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels the periodic timer when widget is disposed to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, showing loading, error, or status information based on current state.
